name: Casablanca Stili — Après-Sport & Sürreal İpek Eşarp
description: 42 gerçek arşiv tasarımından çıkarılmış çok katmanlı sürreal mimari portallar: ters üçgen (V-portal) panoramalar, Greco-Mısır taş sunak ve flamingo/raket simetrileri, L'Arche yaprak-güvercin kemerleri, 45° altın pikap rozet mandalalar, 80'ler airbrush tenis meteorları ve Ukiyo-e/Akdeniz kulüp kolajları.
style_dna: High-density multi-layered Parisian après-sport luxury graphic illustration combining neoclassical Greco-Egyptian and French-Moroccan architectural framing with surreal multi-plane storytelling. Every composition MUST feature four distinct visual depth layers: (1) a razor-sharp geometric portal frame or sculpted stone altar pedestal, (2) a lush foreground botanical or fauna anchor that dynamically overlaps and breaks outside the frame borders, (3) an architectural or sports mid-ground (red-clay tennis court, checkerboard marble courtyard, turquoise cove, or vinyl turntable deck), and (4) a surreal cosmic or atmospheric horizon (twin golden pyramids, retro chrome UFO tractor beam, tennis-ball moon, or radiant sunburst sky). Rendered with luminous hand-painted studio gouache, 1980s retro airbrush gradients, and crisp screen-print ink contours without any fabric texture.

render_modes.prompt: Hybrid Multi-Layer Signature Print Execution: Combine razor-sharp architectural portal borders and crisp hand-inked contours with rich multi-plane gouache illustration and luminous 1980s airbrush atmospheric glow inside the scene. Enforce frame-breaking 3D overlap where foreground palm fronds, bird wings, flames, or aircraft noses project cleanly across the geometric border lines.

Flat Spot Silk-Scarf Execution: Render the entire multi-layer composition strictly with razor-sharp flat solid spot-color fills enclosed by bold uniform hand-inked outlines, zero soft blur, and crisp decorative friezes optimized for direct tramsız flat-spot screen separation.

1980s Retro Airbrush & Studio Gouache Execution: Render the multi-plane centerpiece with glowing cobalt-to-gold airbrush flame gradients, metallic specular highlights, wet-on-dry studio watercolor clouds, and soft pastel sorbet aura transitions enclosed within a crisp print-ready perimeter (ready for LAP + 45 LPI halftone printing).
